'''Classic (no v-cards)''' is a constructed format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>classic_no_virtual</code>) using only Decipher-printed cards: set ids 1&ndash;14 and premium ids 101&ndash;112, with no virtual cards. Cards with the Defensive Shield, Episode I or Maintenance icon are banned.<ref name="gemp" /> Forum threads call it "Classic No-V".<ref name="t85240" /> It is the Decipher-cards-only version of [[Classic]].<ref name="gemp" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib-ec48dc19" />

== Classic (no v-cards) (Modified) ==
GEMP also has '''[[Classic (no v-cards) (Modified)]]''' (code <code>classic_no_virtual_m</code>), with the same pool and 14 Defensive Shields allowed.<ref name="gemp" />
